sources.title: AesSedai/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repo contains specialized MoE-quants for XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD. The idea being that given the huge size of the FFN tensors compared to the rest of the tensors in the model, it should be possible to achieve a better quality while keeping the overall size of the entire model smaller compared to a similar naive quantization.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6 | Xiaomi
sources.snippet: The MiMo-V2.6 series includes two natively omnimodal models: MiMo-V2.6-Pro is our most capable model to date, while MiMo-V2.6-Flash strikes the best balance between intelligence, efficiency, and cost.

sources.title: Xiaomi Releases MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD and Pro-MOPD Models
sources.snippet: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD and MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD possess omni-modal processing capabilities that comprehensively handle text, images, video, and audio, along with strengths specialized for advanced autonomous agent tasks.

sources.title: MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi
sources.snippet: By scaling both model size and compute, MiMo-V2-Pro is built on a stronger foundation. According to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, a leading global benchmark for model comprehensive intelligence, MiMo-V2-Pro ranks 8th worldwide and 2nd in Chinese LLMs.
